source_name: CGHS OM F.No. 5-16/CGHS(HQ)/HEC/2024 (Part I) dated 03.10.2025 - revised package rates

base.note: Annexure I rates are for Tier I (X) cities, semi-private ward, with Non-NABH / NABH / Super Speciality columns.

city_tier_factor.note: Tier II (Y) 10% lower, Tier III (Z) 20% lower than Tier I. North-East, J&K and Ladakh use Tier II rates.

grade_factor.note: Non-NABH/NABL 15% lower than NABH. Super speciality hospitals 15% higher than NABH for their super specialities.

ward_factor.note: General ward 5% lower, private ward 5% higher than semi-private.

ward_uniform_note: Consultations, investigations, radiotherapy, day care procedures and minor procedures not requiring admission are the same for every ward.
